operation_details.item: The R&D budget share was originally set at 40%.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning! I’m reviewing the budget changes ahead of today’s planning discussion.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Good morning. The R&D budget share was originally set at 40%, but we’ve updated it.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Right—the current R&D allocation is 35%, with the difference reallocated to the go-to-market plan.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I wanted the revised split to give the go-to-market work more room without changing the overall budget.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. The new allocation is approved in the budget system, so the planning files should reflect 35% going forward.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Great. I’ll use the approved allocation in the next analysis and budget summary.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only the original 40% R&D share and retain the current 35% allocation and rationale.
